title: Helicopter Services Inc. delivers Airbus H125 to Florida Keys Mosquito Control District
summary: This project represents the second time HSI has performed an aircraft completion project for FKMCD.
body_markdown:
Helicopter completion and MRO provider Helicopter Services, Inc. (HSI) of Spring, Texas, has announced completion and delivery of a new Airbus[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) for the Florida Keys Mosquito Control District (FKMCD).


This project represents the second time HSI has performed an aircraft completion project for FKMCD.


“Our Helicopter Services team is proud to assist airborne mosquito control programs nationally as we have for decades,” said HSI general manager Mike Crossland.


“We are very appreciative of Florida Keys Mosquito Control choosing us to perform another aircraft completion for a high performance Airbus[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) aerial spraying platform.”


Airborne mosquito control, air medical, airborne public safety agencies and private owners all rely on HSI for a range of services.


And HSI staffers are attending the 2026 FMCA/Florida Mosquito Control Association Annual Meeting this month. Team members are available to meet with clients and attendees of this very popular and vital conference.


For the Florida Keys[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) project, HSI installed mission-specific equipment and upgraded the aircraft’s avionics to enhance operational capability, including install of the Garmin GTN650 suite.


HSI focused on turning the aircraft into a smart-design aerial application platform with leading components from Isolair, including the Isolair 4500 Broadcaster dry granular broadcast system as well as the Isolair WDG belly mounted wet spray system.


Further key mission components added by HSI include RSG air conditioning, Donaldson (AFS) Inlet Barrier Filter System, REBTECH NVIS cockpit, AG NAV Guia Platinum Control System, S TEC HeliSAS auto pilot, Spidertracks Mapping System, Technisonic TDFM 9000 radios and DART full length carbide shoes.


Texas’ own Nath Specialty Coatings applied FKMC’s striking custom aircraft paint scheme.


Completion and service work covers airframes from Airbus, Bell, MD Helicopters, Enstrom and other popular brands, in the company’s 25,000 square foot facility at David Wayne Hooks Memorial Airport west of Houston.


The facility includes dedicated shop areas for sheet metal, composite, avionics and other key services.


Helicopter Services, Inc. focuses on project efficiency for its clients, serving as the coordinator and single point of contact for its completion clients.


The many agencies choosing HSI include Dallas Police Department, Apollo Air Medical, REACH Air Medical Service, Florida Keys Mosquito Control District, Missouri Department of Conservation, Harris County Sheriff’s Office, City of Austin, New York City DOHMH, Houston Police Department, and other fine programs.


HSI also continues its growing involvement in air medical aircraft maintenance and completions, offering their well-known quality and expertise to air medical operators nationwide.


Top brands represented by HSI include Airbus Helicopters, Enstrom Helicopters, Garmin, HeliTowCart, Genesys Aerosystems, FreeFlight Systems, Piranha, StartStick and Avidyne.


Visit Helicopter Services Inc./HSI during the 2026 FMCA/Florida Mosquito Control Association Annual Meeting in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla., November 9-12, 2026.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Helicopter Services, Inc.*
